description: Production model (hybrid GLM) as lookup tables. pure premium per policy-year = base_per_policy_year x base_claim_size x exp(sum of frequency and severity log relativities, incl. interactions and the state factor) x icc_bridge x off_balance (per state when off_balance_by_state is given) x county factor. 2025 dollars, average year. Area-level only.

state.note: state factor = the state's average-year level vs the base state (from state x year effects); the state comes from the county code

51515.name: Bedford city (former; part of Bedford County since 2013)

disclaimer: Area-level estimate from aggregated public NFIP data (Virginia, North Carolina and Maryland, 2010-2025). It describes the average insured building with these characteristics in this county in an average year. It is NOT a quote, a premium, or a prediction for any individual property.
